body.name: Influence-weighted finite-lag variance and Wald interval
body.construction: Define \(\widehat w\) by \((gH)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}\widehat\ell_{it}(R_{it}e)=\sum_{j=1}^N\sum_{s=1}^T\widehat w_{js}e_{js}\), where every \(\widehat\ell_{it}\) uses its declared ordered local chart. Set \(\widehat V=\sum_{j=1}^N\sum_{h=-q}^q\widehat\gamma(h)\sum_{s=1}^T\widehat w_{js}\widehat w_{j,s+h}\) and \(\mathrm{CI}_{1-\alpha}=[\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{bc}}\pm z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\widehat V}]\).
